This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: This live browser proof successfully demonstrates the complete end-to-end workflow of creating a room, uploading financial source documents, invoking the NodeAgent, and generating a comprehensive package of financial model deliverables.

featureClarity.evidence: The video clearly shows the upload of multiple financial files and the subsequent invocation of the agent to generate valuation models.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Demonstrates the full sequence from an empty room, document uploads, agent execution with live traces, to the final generated artifacts.

visualDesign.evidence: Polished dark-themed interface with clear panel divisions, though the dense layout can feel slightly crowded during active execution.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the NodeRoom paradigm of combining spreadsheets, documents, chat, and agent traces in a single workspace.

evidenceQuality.evidence: High-fidelity capture of actual browser behavior, showing real-time tool execution, status updates, and artifact rendering.

legibility.evidence: Most UI elements and spreadsheet cells are readable, though trace logs and small status text require close attention.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant for investment banking and financial analysis workflows, showcasing automated DCF valuation modeling.

productionHonesty.evidence: Transparently displays agent execution steps, token usage, and associated costs ($0.06) at the bottom of the screen.

observedEvidence: Upload of multiple Excel and PDF source files
Live streaming tool traces and status updates
Generation and rendering of multiple output artifacts (Excel, Word, PDF)

defects.observed: The PDF preview for the Uber 10-K document displays a loading state briefly before the user switches to another tab.
defects.fix: Ensure PDF previews render fully before navigating away to demonstrate seamless document viewing.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent analyze uploaded financial documents and generate a complete valuation model package, including spreadsheets, presentations, and PDF reports.
